# Aura Arena — AI Movement Intelligence Platform
> Canonical URL: https://auraarena.devamit.co.in/
> Architect: Amit Chakraborty (devamit)
> Stack: React 19, TypeScript, MediaPipe BlazePose, WebGPU, Supabase Realtime, Tailwind CSS, Vite

## Overview
Aura Arena is a real-time AI movement intelligence and competitive computer vision platform. It turns standard webcam and smartphone camera video into sub-16ms competitive gameplay across boxing, dance, martial arts, and functional fitness.

## Core Architecture
- **On-Device Computer Vision**: Runs MediaPipe 33-keypoint 3D skeleton estimation directly in the browser via WebGPU/WASM with zero server video transmission.
- **Biometric Scoring Engine**: Calculates joint angles, velocity, acceleration, rotational torque, and movement cadence in real time.
- **1v1 Multiplayer Battles**: Live peer-to-peer competitive movement matches synchronized through Supabase Realtime websockets.
- **Global Leaderboards**: Verifiable biometric movement scorecards and achievements.
